notes.title: Update Slightly Delayed – But the Beta Build Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’ve decided that the recent big update is too unstable to release in its current state.
This came to light for me after a more rigorous round of play testing.
However, I didn’t want to leave you with nothing, especially after promising something for the 10th. So I’m putting part of the build into SEA (Super Early Access).

You can find instructions on how to join the SEA testing here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2965660/discussions/0/4515507601682535093/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2965660/discussions/0/4515507601682535093/[/url]

[b]So, when will the full update come out?[/b]
I’m still targeting May. I apologise for any frustration caused. I want to make sure the update really delivers and at the moment, it’s just not ready.

I hope you understand why I’ve decided to delay it a bit longer. Thanks so much for your support of Pilgrim - I’m really looking forward to getting this out properly.

As a little teaser, below are the current patch notes currently for the update.
Note: Not everything listed below is in the SEA build - which is a slightly older version of the update.

[spoiler]- Changed voice chat implementation
- Improved interaction system 
- Improvements to the torch not being in front of the camera when head bob is turned off
- Vastly improved procedural generation speed of dungeons
- Increased walk and sprint speed
- Updated road mesh generation (should bring more stability)
- Fixed not being able to switch who you're viewing in spectator mode
- Fixed dead body not dropping correctly from inventory when switching items
- Sped up crystal crush trap to compensate for quicker movement speed
- Reduced Pale speed
- Added a stall to when a monster takes damage. So now they will stop for a bit after being hit.
- Fixing jester hat audio
- Bucket refills in rain 
- Fixed issue where buying equipment from the merchant would override max loan 
- Fixed issue where dropping a piece of equipment would also drop the currently held item
- Allowing picking up of equipment when already holding an item
- Outside monsters now have save game permanence so that when killed they will not re-appear in a loaded game
- Toned down force applied to monsters when hit by spear (so now they shouldn't fly off)
- Fixed money change noises note playing for clients
- Randomising dungeon type order
- Fixing when a newly joined player sees another player turned into a tree it no longer is just the character standing there
- Tree people won't follow you into the Merchant area and stay dead upon reload
- Improved "Pale" enemy pathing and interactions. Should no longer get stuck in the caves
- Adjusting the Pale's kill sphere to be a bit more fair
- Making it so when the Pale is scared off by fire it won't kill a player whilst running away
- Stopping the mimic from activating after a player is cut in half
- Fixed spears not being able to thrown in or near the wagon
- Village no longer removes huge portions of trees when loading in
- Fixed running with lantern causing aggressive flickering
- Added two extra trap rooms
- Added storage area to wagon
- Special loot rooms added to dungeon
- Lock and key mechanics
- Lock picking minigame
- Added crystallette power source
- Added remote communication device
- Added two new enemies
- Added a dungeon type
- Added a point of interest
- Added spectacles that attach to your gear slot and improve vision in interesting ways
- Added a vendor to the merchants section
- Added a map system and upgrades
- Added stat gathering and progress report
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 14.10 - Planting trees is good for the environment 🌳
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Apologies for the lack of updates. I’m still working on the larger release I promised. As many of you know, game development isn’t easy and sometimes life stuff gets in the way.

By my count, there’s still a little time left in January (North American time, at least), so I wanted to get this smaller update out to you. As I haven't been able to dedicate as much time as I would have liked, I want to thank you for your continued patience.

Thanks again for your continued support of PILGRIM!


This smaller update includes fixes, quality of life improvements and even a new enemy. The bigger update is still on the way, but please manage your expectations.
Going forward, I may even remove certain features from the larger update and release them in smaller patches.

Patch Notes:

- Added in a new above ground enemy 🌳
- Fixed wagon moving after new player joins when crystal is drained
- Added potential white screen fix (disable UI effects in settings)
- Better head cull for first person view to stop clipping
- Reduced overall head bobbing and added slider in settings to tune (found in the settings menu under "Game Settings")
- Removed festive decoration
- Fixed equipment (jester hat and pumpkin) not deducting money
- Fixed UI elements (like pickup item) remaining on screen sometimes
- Fixed crystal trap walls bug where the killing noise would repeat
- Fixed spectator camera not responding or spinning
- Added field of view shift when sprinting
- Fixed Imp not taking crystal form clients
- Added flame noise to some places of fire
- Improvements to dead body carrying. Now becomes an inventory slot and the animation is more robust
- Spider nests no longer attach to held dead bodies

notes.title: Patch 14.8 - A Small but Festive Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I wanted to update you on the progress of Pilgrim. While I wasn’t able to release the larger update I’d planned for November, I’ve made a smaller update to swap out the Halloween theme for some festive Christmas visuals! 🎄✨

The new target for the big update is mid to late December. If we happen to miss that window, rest assured it will be ready by January.

Thank you so much for playing and supporting the world of Pilgrim! I’m really excited to share the big update with you all when it's ready.

notes.title: Patch 14.7 - Halloween Update 🎃

It’s been a little while, but I’m back with a small spooky season update. Life stuff happened and so I haven't had time for a big update yet, but I’ve put together something fun that also tests out a new feature, which will have more content later on.
Thanks for sticking around! I’m aiming to get a larger update out sometime in November.

notes.title: Patch 14.5 - Connectivity Improvements
notes.notes:
- Changing the online subsystem to improve connectivity.

- Mapping ladder input to the movement input (allowing for rebinding).
- Changed player name display in character select to be screen-based instead of world-based.
- Expanding the main menu to occupy more of the screen.

notes.title: 1 Month Pilgrimage / Patch 10
notes.notes:
Hi all! Running a little late on this one, but I hope the wait will be worth it. While there’s no extra content yet, I’ve added two massive systems that should make a huge difference: the save system and the ability to re-join games in progress. These features turned out to be quite an undertaking (as anticipated) and took a fair bit of time to get working. They are now at a state where they work pretty well, but they are not without problems (as early access goes), so there may still be issues when loading and re-joining.

I've also snuck in some quality of life improvements and more stability changes, which will hopefully reduce disconnects.

Crazy to think that it's already been a month since Pilgrim released! Thank you all for your reviews, feedback and positivity on the game - it's been so encouraging :) 
Can't wait for you all to see what's coming next.

Here are the patch notes for this build:

Patch 10

- Adding save system
- Allowing join in progress
- Fixing password required bug
- invert mouse movement option
- Mouse sensitivity slider
- Stopping wagon when player that is pushing disconnects
- Added display to see when games are password protected

notes.title: Patch 8 - Applying the connectivity fix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thank you all for your ongoing patience in waiting for a fix for the connectivity issues. 
I think I have solved the main cause of the problem that most of you were getting.
However, this will not resolve all connection issues as fixing any kind of multiplayer connection problems can be very difficult to diagnose/fix. There are just so many different reasons players might not be able to connect.

I managed to reliably reproduce a certain kind of disconnect that I believe was affecting most people and then I reliably connected after the patch. 

A massive thank you to those of you that have been reporting bugs and specifically the details of this connectivity issue - I hope this patch solves the problem! 

Last point - this patch might well break connectivity for people that were previously fine! At my scale it's tough to test these problems without going live to see what will happen. If this turns out to be the case then I'm sorry and I'll revert back to the last working version asap. Please comment in the Discussions or on this post if you're having problems!

- Applying fix for connection issues
- Allowing body pickup after stalker kill

notes.title: 1 Week of PILGRIM! / Patch 6
notes.notes:
1 Week of PILGRIM! / Patch 6

Hi Everyone! PILGRIM has been out for a week now! 🥳

It's been amazing seeing everyone get stuck in. It's so rewarding to see so many people playing the game and even watching it on various streams from around the world.

We also want to thank you all for bearing with us as we continue to iron out the bugs and connectivity issues! We really appreciate all the support and reviews of the game ❤️

As a little celebration of the game being out for a full week, we're putting out this patch with a brand new addition, and it's quite big (physically anyway). I'd love to tell you what it is right now... but I think it'll be more fun if you find out for yourself.

As usual, here are the patch notes for today:

notes.title: PILGRIM IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014576/7f59c3aa5d586270b31b6d7c770453d526375b7f.png[/img]

PILGRIM IS OUT NOW!

The gate keeper has let you out of the city walls to start your pilgrimage. How far will you make it?

We're so excited to finally let people play PILGRIM! 

As PILGRIM is in Early Access please expect bugs and balance issues here and there. It would be fantastic if you could report those in the forums or on our growing discord community: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FNJvz6JuKar]Discord Join Link[/url]

We will have a proper road map setup in the future. But for now the following are high priority major tasks. Please expect regular builds and updates for bug fixing in between major updates.

[list]
[*] Save Games
[*] Push to Talk (as of right now the voice channel is always open)
[*] Post game report (stats)
[*] Global Leader boards (to see who has made it the furthest into the pilgrimage!)
[*] Passwords for servers
[/list]

notes.title: RELEASE DAY ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Release Time Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014576/ff67d272abd351d69995da65e5459b48204db35c.png[/img]

Hi All! 

We're super excited to launch the game into early access and had planned to release today at 6:30GMT.

However, the Steam review process has taken longer than anticipated (at no fault of Steam!) The build of the game was put in for review on Monday hoping that it would be approved before today - so as of right now the build is still in the review queue and we don't know when it will be done. If it's not approved for release by tomorrow then the next available day should be Monday. 

Thank you for your patience - we can't wait for you all to play PILGRIM!
